en: Six resolutions in one Resolution menu: stock UHD/FHD, a Super 16 crop (2096x1238 at 1:1), the binned OG2K and OG3K open gates, and OG3.5K (3456x2308 from the whole sensor, ISP-scaled). 12-bit CinemaDNG, native UI. OG3.5K needs an external SSD. Alpha.
zh: 一個解析度選單裡有六種格式:原廠 UHD/FHD、Super 16 裁切(2096x1238,1:1)、合併像素的 OG2K 與 OG3K 開放式全片幅,以及 OG3.5K(3456x2308,全感光元件讀出、ISP 縮圖)。12-bit CinemaDNG,原生 UI;OG3.5K 需要外接 SSD。Alpha。
